origin.description: Test whether Geary's kurtosis of a normal sample equals sqrt(2/pi).

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector. Missing values are dropped.

origin.details: tau is the mean absolute deviation. z compares 13.29 times the log of the root mean square over tau with 3. less keeps the upper tail.
origin.value: An htest with tau, its z, and the p-value.
